candidates.tagline: A 'routine' router upgrade just grounded every flight in America.
candidates.story: On November 13, 2026, contractor L3Harris turned on a new Cisco 600 router during a copper-to-fibre upgrade at a remote FAA site in Arkansas — it immediately began flooding the FAA's flight-control network with ~1,000 connection attempts per second, triggering only the third nationwide ground stop in US aviation history. Over 10,000 flights were disrupted; the router's manufacturer insists the devices 'did not fail.'
candidates.why_funny: The company responsible for protecting America's skies managed to ground every single flight by plugging in a router, and the router maker's official response is that it worked exactly as designed.
candidates.alt: Passengers at a Delta Airlines gate at JFK airport staring at a departures board covered in red CANCELLED labels during the November 13 2026 FAA nationwide ground stop, one traveller holding his head in his hands

candidates.tagline: 35 years of 'Maybe it's Maybelline.' Retired. For this.
candidates.story: On November 10, 2026, Maybelline retired its iconic 35-year-old tagline 'Maybe she's born with it. Maybe it's Maybelline.' — replacing it globally with 'Maybe. We're born with it. Maybe. It's Maybelline.' in a campaign fronted by Miley Cyrus; Allure called it the destruction of 'one of the greatest beauty slogans ever written,' saying 'both its rhythm and satisfying payoff are now gone.'
candidates.why_funny: One of the most memorised advertising slogans in history, repeated across four decades and every continent, was swapped for a version that reads like someone sat on the period key.
candidates.alt: Maybelline New York cosmetics store front inside Nanxiang Incity Mega shopping mall in Shanghai, showing the brand's blue backlit signage and digital screens displaying makeup models
